title: Luscious Shaggy Chinese Noodles Sweet And Sour
description: A winey, shaggy, festive Chinese dish featuring noodles, en-croute, and a sweet and sour flavor profile, wrapped in a ti-leaf for a unique presentation. This dish is gluten-free-friendly and perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the chopped bell pepper and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the diced pork and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the sweet and sour sauce and stir to combine.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and let cook for 2 minutes.
Cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
To assemble the dish, lay a ti leaf flat and place a portion of the noodle mixture in the center.
Spoon the sweet and sour pork mixture over the noodles and sprinkle with chopped green onion.
Drizzle with sesame oil and serve immediately.
